entities.name: Query kynureninase
observations: 405 aa soluble enzyme candidate with Aminotran_5 domain (PF00266.26; residues 86–330) and KYNU_C domain (PF22580.3; residues 309–398).
Shares 46.2% identity over 96.0% query coverage with reviewed Pseudomonas fluorescens kynureninase P83788; E-value 3.32e-121.
Shares 45.3% identity over 95.8% query coverage with reviewed Burkholderia mallei kynureninases A3MHE2 and A2S925; E-value 2.16e-119.
Functional assignment is moderate homology support, not direct assay evidence for this exact sequence.

entities.name: P83788
observations: Uses pyridoxal 5'-phosphate and cleaves L-kynurenine and 3-hydroxy-L-kynurenine.

entities.name: L-kynurenine hydrolytic cleavage
observations: Reaction: L-kynurenine + H2O → anthranilate + L-alanine + H+; mapped to Rhea RHEA:16813 and EC 3.7.1.3 in reviewed kynureninase homologs.

entities.name: 3-hydroxy-L-kynurenine hydrolytic cleavage
observations: Reaction: 3-hydroxy-L-kynurenine + H2O → 3-hydroxyanthranilate + L-alanine + H+; mapped to Rhea RHEA:25143 in reviewed kynurenase homologs.

entities.name: Pyridoxal 5'-phosphate
observations: Reported cofactor for reviewed kynurenase homolog P83788 and related curated homologs; ChEBI:CHEBI:597326.
